adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, legacy SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts entries are copied with raw SQL: `INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`, which bypasses the EmbeddableHost model's `before_validation` normalization that strips scheme/path. The new lookup path (`EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` -> `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`) only matches normalized hostnames (e.g., `discourse.org`). If the old setting contained values like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (explicitly shown as valid inputs by the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` logic and reflected in updated tests fabricating such values), those rows would be inserted unnormalized and would no longer match `uri.host`, breaking embedding for those hosts after upgrade.
